_doc: Every parameter of the look, under the names of the reference implementation (base_vhs / vhs / base_crt / crt, tube / camera / treatments). A look = a tape preset (V*), optionally a tube preset (C*) and a tube treatment (T*), and a capture mode: direct (the tape into a capture card), screen (the CRT face captured cleanly) or filmed (a camera filming the CRT). Units: TVL = TV lines per picture height at 10 % MTF; samples = 1/720 of the picture height along a line (960 per line on a 4:3 picture); lines = 1/480 of the picture height; triad units = one phosphor triad pitch.

V1.name: SP first generation (camcorder original)
V1.title: Camcorder original, SP
V1.desc: The camcorder's own SP tape played on a home VCR: about 240 TVL luma, 36 TVL chroma, light tape noise, a few dropouts, mild edge-enhancement halos.

V2.name: SP second-generation dub (tape-ministry copy)
V2.title: Second-generation SP dub
V2.desc: The master dubbed deck to deck at SP: bandwidth lost twice, noise twice, double halos, chroma delay accumulates, colour weaker.

V3.name: EP long-play dub (6-hour copy)
V3.title: EP long-play dub
V3.desc: A copy recorded at EP, one third tape speed: about 200 TVL, 30 TVL chroma, much higher luma and chroma noise, more jitter and dropouts, softer and duller.

V4.name: Worn SP, played for 18 years
V4.title: Worn SP tape
V4.desc: The original tape after hundreds of plays: oxide-shedding dropouts, a tracking noise band near the bottom, stronger tape-stretch wobble and top flagging, faded colour, clogged-head softness.

V5.name: Hot tungsten, tube camcorder
V5.title: Tube camcorder, hot tungsten
V5.desc: SP original from a Saticon pickup-tube camcorder under hot tungsten light: highlights bloom and leave comet tails, warm white balance, saturated reds smear right through the colour-under channel.

V6.name: Near clean (good deck, SP original)
V6.title: Clean deck, SP original
V6.desc: The SP original on a well-aligned deck: the format's bandwidth and chroma delay stay, noise and time-base error are nearly gone, no dropouts. The floor of what reads as VHS.

V7.name: SP original, CCD camcorder gain-up
V7.title: CCD camcorder, gain-up
V7.desc: A 1987 CCD camcorder in a dim room: AGC gain noise baked in before the tape, vertical smear streaks above and below hot lights, cooler auto white balance.

C1.name: Dot-triad shadow mask
C1.title: Dot-triad shadow mask
C1.desc: Delta-gun shadow mask: round R, G, B phosphor dots on a hexagonal lattice, about 1.0 mm pitch. Classic tube texture up close.

C2.name: Slot mask (in-line gun), typical 2005 set
C2.title: Slot mask, typical consumer set
C2.desc: What most consumer CRTs of the 1990s and 2000s used: vertical R, G, B slots in staggered columns with thin bridges, about 1.0 mm pitch, moderate beam bloom.

C3.name: Aperture grille (Trinitron) with damper wires
C3.title: Aperture grille with damper wires
C3.desc: Aperture-grille tube: continuous vertical phosphor stripes, no bridges, two thin horizontal damper-wire shadows at about 1/3 and 2/3 of the height, crisper and brighter.

C4.name: Slot mask, tired tube: soft beam, heavy halation
C4.title: Tired tube, soft beam
C4.desc: An older, hotter-driven tube: fat defocused beam that hides the raster in bright areas, wide faceplate halation around highlights, slight corner misconvergence.

C5.name: Slot mask, sharp beam: strong scanlines
C5.title: Sharp beam, strong scanlines
C5.desc: A well-focused tube at moderate brightness: thin beams with dark gaps between lines in the darks, minimal bloom and halation. The most legible raster.

tube._doc: The tube's build and treatment (the reference tube settings and shader defaults). fill = how much of the frame the raster spans (1 = edge to edge, rounded corners in frame; below 1 the bezel shows). curvature = 0 for a flat-face tube, up to 1 for a strongly curved older set.

camera._doc: The filming camera: exposure, lens bloom above a luminance knee, wide glare, and camera-side grain (8-bit levels, uniform, per frame).

T0.title: Baseline
T0.desc: The tube as built, no treatment.

T1.title: Washed out
T1.desc: Milky faceplate scatter and lifted blacks in the raster, lower contrast, cool 9300 K white, mild desaturation.

T2.title: Lines visible
T2.desc: The camera records one 240-line field, thinner beams, the mask just perceptible.

T3.title: Hot and bloomy
T3.desc: Brightness and contrast up, whites bloom and smear right, the stamp glows, halation in the glass.

T4.title: Aged tube
T4.desc: Dimmer, faint yellow-green phosphor, softer corners, slight misconvergence, a touch of pincushion.

T5.title: Filmed CRT, rolling bar
T5.desc: A faint slow rolling refresh bar (camera shutter not synced to 60 Hz) and a hint of mask moire.

T6.title: One field, cool white
T6.desc: One recorded field (240 lines), a little milky lift in the raster and a cool white, light smear, a very faint roll.

vhs-on-tv.title: VHS on a TV, filmed
vhs-on-tv.desc: The full chain: a second-generation SP dub on a slot-mask TV, filmed with a camera that records one field, with a cool white and a faint roll.

church-dub.title: Dubbed church tape
church-dub.desc: A second-generation SP dub, captured straight from the deck.

home-camcorder.title: Home camcorder tape
home-camcorder.desc: A camcorder original on SP, played on a home VCR and captured straight from the deck.

clean-deck.title: Clean deck
clean-deck.desc: The cleanest tape that still reads as VHS: format bandwidth and chroma delay, almost no noise.

ep-longplay.title: EP long-play copy
ep-longplay.desc: A six-hour EP dub: soft, noisy, dull colour, more dropouts.

worn-tape.title: Worn tape
worn-tape.desc: Played hundreds of times: dropouts, a tracking noise band, wobble, faded colour.

tube-camcorder.title: Tube camcorder
tube-camcorder.desc: Pickup-tube camera under hot tungsten: blooming highlights with comet tails, warm white balance.

ccd-gain-up.title: CCD gain-up
ccd-gain-up.desc: Dim-room CCD camcorder: gain noise and vertical smear through bright lights.

consumer-tv.title: Consumer TV
consumer-tv.desc: A camcorder tape on a slot-mask consumer set, the screen captured cleanly.

filmed-tv.title: Filmed off a TV
filmed-tv.desc: A camcorder tape on a consumer set, filmed with a camera: one recorded field, lens bloom, grain, the bezel in frame.

trinitron.title: Aperture-grille TV
trinitron.desc: The tape on an aperture-grille tube: stripes, damper-wire shadows, crisper and brighter.

sharp-scanlines.title: Sharp scanlines
sharp-scanlines.desc: A well-focused tube: thin beams, visible line gaps in the darks.

tired-tube.title: Tired tube
tired-tube.desc: An old hot-driven tube: fat beam, heavy halation, misconvergence in the corners.

curved-80s-set.title: Curved 1980s set
curved-80s-set.desc: A curved-face dot-mask set of the era, bezel in frame, filmed with a camera.

washed-out-tv.title: Washed-out TV
washed-out-tv.desc: Milky faceplate, lifted blacks, cool white, filmed with a camera.

hot-bloomy-tv.title: Hot, bloomy TV
hot-bloomy-tv.desc: Brightness up, whites bloom and smear, halation in the glass, filmed with a camera.
